posts.author: Mredzinsky
posts.body:
Welcome to
"Dreadful Night at School"
– a
dark thriller
created by an RPG Maker fan, for all fans!
Imagine spending a night at school with a group of friends. Sounds like a great idea for fun, right? But as darkness falls, the atmosphere becomes a bit... unsettling. Suddenly, amidst fun and giggles, strange things are about to happen. One of your companions has sinister intentions, and the fun quickly turns into a terrifying events!
Throughout the game, you will need to observe the characters behavior and try to uncover who is behind the dark crimes. The school, which was supposed to be a place of adventure, turns into a maze full of dangers. Escape? Well, it may not be that simple...
Will you manage to unmask the guilty one and escape the school, or will you end up as another victim in this night adventure? Clues await, and the truth may be closer than it seems.
Price: 1,99$
Engine: RPG Maker MV
Language: Polish/English
Genre: Thriller
Credits: "Credits" on Title screen
One-night lenght:
A game designed for a single evening session that you won't regret.
Graphics:
Pixel art familiar from RPG Maker games, enhanced with beautiful lighting effects and original renders straight from Blender.
Story:
A narrative filled with twists and moments you won't forget for a long time. Will you manage to uncover who is responsible for the chaos faster than the others?
Enjoyable Gameplay:
The game is easy to complete without a walkthrough, thanks to the "thought" system. This allows you to fully immerse yourself in the story.

posts.author: Mredzinsky
posts.body:
Dreadful Night at School got a massive update. Just to let you know if you're interested in playing in the future. I don't plan any further changes besides possible bugfixes.
Spoiler:
Changelog
Added:
Objects in the starting location now have a white outline to make them easier to find.
New graphics related to the exit doors have been added in the starting location.
Camera movement and zoom have been added in certain interactions and cutscenes.
Flies now flies around a light bulb in the basement.
Language selection is available when launching the game for the first time or when starting a new game.
Fullscreen mode is available, with the option to toggle it in the settings.
The main menu is skipped if there are no save files in the game folder.
More animations have been added in cutscenes.
Graphics of Matt and Mia have been added in the lobby and nurse's room.
A graphic of Mia’s bloodied hand has been added.
A graphic of Nadia sawing through bars has been added.
School paintings and banners have been added to the corridors on the ground floor.
...and several more small additions.
Changed:
Some thoughts were improved and rewritten to better suggest what actions need to be taken.
The scene in the nurse's room during the bandaging sequence has been refined.
Matt's face is changed in conversations after his head is bandaged.
The dialogue window in the nurse's room was moved to the top of the screen to better reveal the characters.
Character movements were updated and completed in the final scene in classroom 18.
The scene in Twain's room was reanimated and redesigned.
The police station was brightened.
Some dialogues in Polish.
Some dialogues in English.
Gaps in the English translation were filled.
...and several more minor changes.
Fixed:
Fixed a bug causing incorrect spawn locations in the nurse's room in certain cases.
Fixed a bug preventing entry to classroom 10 after a cutscene.
Fixed a bug where Adam's position was not updated in Negrete’s room.
Fixed character paths in the final scene in the gym.
Fixed the loading of lighting effects in the final scene in the gym.
Fixed some lighting effects.
Fixed a bug where Mia displayed the wrong graphic at the end of the game.
Fixed a looping dialogue issue with David, Wojthas, and Thomas in the gym.
...and other minor fixes.
